creative.headline: Free for your first 10 clients
creative.description: No card. The CRM for independent agents on the Costa del Sol.
creative.primary_text:
Your first 10 clients on LeadWing are free. Forever, and without a card.

Bring your buyer list over from Excel or CSV. Check every row in a preview before anything saves, and undo the whole import in one click if it looks wrong.

Every buyer in one place: budget, viewings, offers, documents, and the next follow-up already drafted.

Built for independent agents on the Costa del Sol. Start free: leadwing.app/start

known_weaknesses: The audience is still the three interests - property-curious consumers, not working agents. Meta cannot target agents in Spain at all (26 Sep). The hook changes; who sees it does not.

Hook/landing mismatch: /start's headline is 'Still tracking clients in a spreadsheet?', not the free offer. The free offer is in its CTA and note only. A /free (ES /gratis) landing that repeats the hook would fix this - site code, needs a separate yes.
EUR 25 buys roughly 85 landing page views at the quiet-leads rate of EUR 0.30. Against 0 signups from 154 views so far, that is a weak test: it can show life, it cannot prove absence.
The app screenshot shows 'Mon 21 Sep' inside the mock. Known, previously accepted as not worth a re-render.
waste_test: Applies as always: pause without asking if more than half the spend goes to audience_network, or clicks under EUR 0.05 with landing views below 30% of clicks. Also report off-feed SHARE of the day's spend, since the 27 Sep leak did not trip the test.
